# `dashboard/views/workflow.ts`

## Overview

This module renders the workflow dashboard view, including a full pipeline diagram with optional task-status highlighting, collapsible architecture diagrams, and a complete workflow page with task selection. It exports two public functions — `pipelinePartial` and `workflowPage` — alongside several internal helpers for building SVG/HTML fragments.

---

## Named Exports

### `pipelinePartial`

```ts
import { pipelinePartial } from '...'
```

Returns an HTML fragment for the full pipeline diagram.

When `taskStatus` is provided, the active stage is highlighted and HTMX polling is enabled. When no task is selected (`taskStatus` is `null`), all stages are rendered in their default slate colors.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `taskStatus` | `string \| null` | The current status of the active task, or `null` if no task is selected. |
| `taskId` | `string` *(optional)* | The ID of the active task. |
| `taskTitle` | `string` *(optional)* | The display title of the active task. |

**Returns:** `string` — An HTML fragment string for the pipeline diagram.

**Example**

```ts
// No task selected — renders all stages in slate/default colors
const html = pipelinePartial(null);

// Task selected — highlights active stage and enables HTMX polling
const html = pipelinePartial('running', 'task-42', 'Build & Test');
```

---

### `workflowPage`

```ts
import { workflowPage } from '...'
```

Renders the full workflow page, including a task dropdown and the pipeline diagram.

The pipeline is always visible. When no task is selected it renders in default colors as a visual showcase; when a task is selected it renders with appropriate stage highlighting.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tasks` | `TaskRow[]` | The list of tasks to populate the task dropdown. |
| `user` | `SessionUser` | The currently authenticated session user. |

**Returns:** `string` — A complete HTML page string.

**Example**

```ts
import { workflowPage } from '...'

const html = workflowPage(tasks, sessionUser);
res.send(html);
```

---
